card.title: PlayStation 5 Troubleshooting Guide: Rails, Sequencers, and Faults
symptoms: Can’t perform this action. Multiple USB drives are connected

claims.statement: When the console gets standby power and is stuck at 7mA draw, check the voltages of the Dialog IC, the frequency of the 25MHz and 32KHz clocks of the Southbridge IC, and whether the Southbridge is accessing the BIOS IC.
claims.evidence: Standby boot sequence current draw behavior analysis.
claims.quote: When console get’s standby power if it is stuck at 7mA. Check the voltages of Dialog ic and frequency of the 25Mhz clock and the 32Khz clock of the Southbridge IC. If that is working, try to see if the Southbridge is acc

claims.statement: If the error message during a USB firmware update states that multiple USB drives are connected when only one is, the APU is faulty and unfixable.
claims.evidence: USB data lines go direct to the APU.
claims.quote: If the error message is: Can’t perform this action. Multiple USB drives are connected APU is faulty and not fixable Connect USB drive to update console USB data lines go direct to the APU

claims.statement: To diagnose a faulty SSD controller when seeing a standby current draw of 175mA dropping back to 10mA, remove fuse F7520 and measure current draw in series with the pads using a multimeter.
claims.evidence: A good working SSD circuit draws 310mA.
claims.quote: When you see a current draw in standby of 175 mA and then back to 10Ma. There can be a bad SSD controller IC. Remove fuse F7520 that feeds the voltage on the back to the voltage regulator that generates power for the SSD

claims.statement: If the HDMI Encoder IC fails, it can cause no picture, no power, blue light of death, or 2 seconds of death symptoms.
claims.quote: If the Encoder IC fails, you can get • No Picture • No Power • blue light of death • Also 2 seconds of death

claims.statement: If 3.3V STBY is missing, the power buttons will not work.
claims.evidence: Power requirements for the Southbridge, Encoder IC, switching regulator, Dialog PMIC, and WiFi IC.
claims.quote: If 3.3V STBY is missing the power buttons will not work. Southbridge, Encoder IC, a switching regulator, Dialog Power management IC, WiFi IC needs 3.3V to operate.

claims.statement: When the console beeps 3 times and does not power on while all voltages are OK, it could be a BIOS corruption.
claims.quote: When console beep 3 times but not powers on check all voltages if all ok it could be a BIOS corruption.

claims.statement: The disc drive board is paired or married to the APU; replacing it can cause issues like no online gaming after update, inability to update, or no disc drive support.
claims.quote: Disc drive board is paired / married to ps5 console No online gaming after update Can’t update console No disc drive support Paired to the APU

procedure: {'step': 'Check for liquid metal spills on the mainboard, APU seals, and under the APU.'}
{'step': 'Probe the board in diode mode to find shorts across power rails.'}
{'step': 'Check the board with a thermal camera to locate hot spots or abnormalities indicating shorts.'}
{'step': 'Remove fuse F7520 to isolate the SSD circuit when investigating abnormal standby current drops.'}
{'step': 'Measure current draw in series with fuse F7520 pads using a multimeter set to current mode.'}
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Checking for shorts by injecting power or probing blindly without verifying rail states can cause further damage.
Watch out for liquid metal spills under seals or under the APU causing shorts or hot spots.
card.caveats: A blue light of death or multi-beep condition can stem from virtually any subsystem failure; always verify rail measurements and current draws rather than guessing.
